plan.notes: Source: official Metropolitan State University of Denver 2024-2025 Undergraduate Catalog, 'Nursing Major - Traditional Nursing Option, B.S.N.' (College of Health and Human Sciences). The catalog publishes degree requirements with no official semester-by-semester sequence — collected as a single requirements block. The Traditional Nursing Option (TNO) is for students without a previous baccalaureate degree; separate competitive admission to the Nursing program is required. Program total: minimum 120 semester hours. This plan records the 31-credit prerequisite block (at 31-credit minimum), the 58-credit required nursing courses, and the 5-credit Senior Experience (the catalog names no specific senior-experience course, so it is recorded as a generic slot). Choice slots recorded at catalog minimum per convention: BIO 2000 (4) over BIO 2400 (5); CHE 1100+CHE 1150 over CHE 1800+CHE 1801. Not itemized here (generic catalog categories, no specific courses published on the program page): General Studies 33 credits, Ethnic Studies & Social Justice 0-3 credits, unrestricted electives 0-2 credits. Prerequisite courses may also count toward General Studies. A grade of C or better is required in each program course.
